citations.title: About Lago - Lago
excerpts:
1. What is Lago?
Lago is the leading open-source pricing solution focused on complex billing: multi-product/geographies, transactional, usage-based, subscription hybrids, etc, chosen by unicorns like Mistral (AI, $13.7 billion valuation), Accel-backed Swan (Embedded banking), or Groq (AI, $6.9 billion valuation).
Lago is API-first, the most loved billing solution on Github, and was voted Product of the day week, and month on Product Hunt.
Lago raised a total of $22M of funding from investors including Y Combinator, FirstMark Capital, SignalFire, Meghan Gill , who has led the monetization efforts of MongoDB for 14 years, Romain Huet , former head of Developer Relations at Stripe - now leading OpenAI developer experience, and Clément Delangue , CEO of AI open platform Hugging Face.
3. What is Lago origin story?
Lago was founded in 2021 by Anh-Tho and Raffi, who were among the earliest employees at Qonto.com – a $5B B2B neobank. They led Qonto’s revenue growth from pre-product to Series D, and built and scaled the monetization system that took the company from 0 to $100M+ of revenue.
The worst was that at some point, the “pricing strategy” nearly switched to “what’s the easiest option to implement”, rather than “what’s the best for the company”.
Raffi and Anh-Tho, and the founding Lago team then spent a lot of time carefully analyzing why no one had solved this huge problem yet, as they thought solid companies like Stripe or Chargebee had partially addressed it.
That’s how they built our conviction on the open-source and “platform” approach of Lago, to not be another “buy billing” option, but rather a “Lego ” that engineers build with to create their tailored monetization stack.

About us
The AI-native billing platform
Every company needs billing. Lago is open-source and gives you the flexibility of a homegrown system with the features of an enterprise-grade vendor.
Book demo Explore open roles
Billing shouldn't suck
Getting paid should be the easy part. But billing systems make it hard. For the longest time, you had to buy a third-party black box or waste time constructing your own billing. Lago fixes that.
It's not a problem that goes viral on social media, but it's ubiquitous in tech companies.
At one of Europe's biggest fintechs, we saw the “billing nightmare”: 10+ full-time engineers worked on billing alone. Product grew frustrated because pricing took months. Finance labored in spreadsheets they shouldn't need.
Millions of invoices later, we're happy to support emerging and established leaders on billing so they can focus on building, not billing.

About Lago
Copy page Copy page
Lago is the company and open-source project building transparent, programmable billing infrastructure.
Copy page Copy page
Lago builds open-source, API-first billing infrastructure.
The platform helps engineering, product, and finance teams meter usage, manage subscriptions, configure pricing, issue invoices, orchestrate payments, and understand revenue without relying on an opaque billing black box.
​
Why Lago exists
Billing becomes difficult when a company supports multiple products, geographies, contract types, usage dimensions, and payment providers. Internal systems often grow into fragile collections of jobs and spreadsheets, while closed vendors can make pricing changes and data access hard.
Lago combines a programmable API and open-source codebase with a visual interface so teams can keep control while avoiding the cost of building every billing primitive themselves.
​
Company
Lago was founded in 2021 by Anh-Tho Chuong and Raffi Sarkissian after experiencing the operational cost of complex billing systems firsthand. Get Lago Corp. develops and supports the Lago platform. Read the fuller company story , explore open roles , or visit the contact page for help and commercial questions.

Company mission
To make data accessible and usable to anybody, starting with growth teams.
Our take
Lago is an open-source billing API for product-led SaaS with a pricing that combines subscription and usage-based dimensions, self-serve and sales-led go-to-market.
While traditional tools to segment and synchronize customer data are often costly and require dedicated engineers to implement, Lago offers an alternative.
The company allows growth teams to do this themselves without having to code by offering an spreadsheet-like interface on which to manage and plan their audience.
Lago received investment from Y Combinator to help it reach global stage from the get-go.
Capital and resources enabled Lago to reach a global audience immediately with users from all continents and world-class mentors and investors that will help the company grow and develop its product.
